# @lab900/ui: instructions for AI agents

This file tells a coding agent how to use `@lab900/ui` in an Angular application. It ships inside
the npm package at `node_modules/@lab900/ui/AGENTS.md`. Point your agent to it from the `AGENTS.md`
or `CLAUDE.md` of your project:

```md
UI components come from `@lab900/ui`. Read `node_modules/@lab900/ui/AGENTS.md` before you use them.
```

The type definitions in `node_modules/@lab900/ui/types/lab900-ui.d.ts` are the source of truth for every
signature. Live examples with their source: https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-ui/

Without the package installed, read https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-ui/llms.txt (an index) or
https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-ui/llms-full.txt (this guide plus the full API reference).

## Rules

1. Import every symbol from `@lab900/ui`. Never import from a deep path such as
   `@lab900/ui/lib/...`: those paths are not part of the public API.
2. Every component and directive is standalone. Add it to the `imports` of the component that uses
   it. There is no `NgModule` to import.
3. Components take a **config object** instead of many inputs. Build the config in the component
   class, type it with the exported interface (`ActionButton<T>`, `TableCell<T>`, `NavItemGroup`),
   and bind it. Keep configs that hold functions or signals in the class, not in the template.
4. Labels, titles and tooltips are **translation keys**. The library runs them through the
   `translate` pipe of `@ngx-translate/core`. A plain text that has no key shows as is.
5. Signal inputs: bind them in a template, or use `fixture.componentRef.setInput()` in a test.
   Never assign to them.
6. The table does not change your data. It emits events (`sortChange`, `cellValueChanged`,
   `tableRowOrderChange`, ...) and you update `data` yourself.

## Setup

### Versions

The major version of `@lab900/ui` matches the Angular major. Version 22 needs Angular 22 or later.
Peer dependencies: `@angular/core`, `common`, `router`, `platform-browser`, `cdk`, `material`
(>= 22), `@ngx-translate/core` (>= 18) and `rxjs` (>= 7.4).

```bash
npm install @lab900/ui @angular/material @angular/cdk @ngx-translate/core
```

### Providers

```ts
import { provideZoneChangeDetection } from '@angular/core';
import { provideRouter } from '@angular/router';
import { provideNativeDateAdapter } from '@angular/material/core';
import { provideTranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';

bootstrapApplication(AppComponent, {
  providers: [
    provideZoneChangeDetection(), // the library uses zone.js
    provideRouter(routes), // nav list, bread crumbs and page header use the router
    provideTranslateService({ lang: 'en', fallbackLang: 'en' }), // required: every label goes through TranslatePipe
    provideNativeDateAdapter(), // only for CellDateEditorComponent, or use another Material DateAdapter
  ],
});
```

Without a `TranslateService` every library component fails with `NullInjectorError`.

### Styles

```scss
@use '@angular/material' as mat;
@use '@lab900/ui/theming' as lab900;

$theme: mat.m2-define-light-theme(
  (
    color: (
      primary: mat.m2-define-palette(mat.$m2-indigo-palette),
      accent: mat.m2-define-palette(mat.$m2-pink-palette),
    ),
  )
);

@include lab900.lab900-ui($theme);
```

The mixin reads colors with `mat.m2-get-color-config`, so it needs a Material 2 theme or color
config (`m2-define-light-theme` / `m2-define-dark-theme`), not a Material 3 `mat.theme()` map.

Icons use `mat-icon` with ligatures. Load the Material Icons font in `index.html`. For an
`svgIcon: true` option, register the svg in `MatIconRegistry` first.

## Component index

| Need                              | Use                                                                    | Main config type                      |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Data table                        | `Lab900TableComponent` (`lab900-table`)                                | `TableCell<T>[]`                      |
| Button with menu, toggle, tooltip | `Lab900ActionButtonComponent` (`lab900-action-button`)                 | `ActionButton<T>`                     |
| Simple button                     | `Lab900ButtonComponent` (`lab900-button`)                              | inputs                                |
| Side navigation                   | `Lab900NavListComponent` (`lab900-nav-list`)                           | `NavItemGroup[]`                      |
| Page title, tabs, actions, crumbs | `Lab900PageHeaderComponent` (`lab900-page-header`)                     | `PageHeaderNavItem[]`, `BreadCrumb[]` |
| Bread crumbs only                 | `BreadCrumbsComponent` (`lab900-bread-crumbs`)                         | `BreadCrumb[]`                        |
| Inline message                    | `AlertComponent` (`lab900-alert`)                                      | `Alert` enum                          |
| Confirm before an action          | `ConfirmationDialogDirective` (`[lab900ConfirmationDialog]`)           | inputs                                |
| Alert or confirm dialog from code | `AlertDialogComponent`, `ConfirmationDialogComponent` with `MatDialog` | `AlertDialog`, `ConfirmationDialog`   |
| Compare and merge two objects     | `Lab900MergerComponent` (`lab900-merger`)                              | `MergeConfig<T>[]`                    |
| Throttle a click                  | `PreventDoubleClickDirective` (`[lab900PreventDoubleClick]`)           | inputs                                |

## Reactive options

Many config fields have the type `ReactiveOption<PAYLOAD, RETURN>` (`ReactiveBooleanOption`,
`ReactiveStringOption`). Such a field accepts three forms:

```ts
const plain: ActionButton<User> = { label: 'edit', disabled: true };
const fromData: ActionButton<User> = { label: 'edit', disabled: user => user.locked }; // the row, or the `data` input
const fromSignal: ActionButton<User> = { label: 'edit', disabled: this.saving }; // updates when the signal changes
```

The function may also return a signal. Use a signal for state that changes over time: the component
reads it in a `computed`, so the view updates without a new config object.

The older `propValue<T, R>` type (used by `TableCell.label`, `TableCellTooltip`, `BreadCrumb`) accepts
a plain value or a function, not a signal.

## Action buttons

```ts
import { ActionButton, Lab900ActionButtonComponent } from '@lab900/ui';

@Component({
  imports: [Lab900ActionButtonComponent],
  template: `<lab900-action-button [action]="save" />`,
})
export class EditComponent {
  private readonly saving = signal(false);

  protected readonly save: ActionButton = {
    label: 'actions.save',
    type: 'flat', // 'raised' | 'stroked' | 'flat' | 'icon' | 'fab' | 'mini-fab' | 'toggle'
    color: 'primary',
    prefixIcon: 'save',
    disabled: this.saving,
    tooltip: { value: 'actions.save-tooltip', position: 'below' },
    action: ({ event, data, actionRef }) => this.onSave(),
  };
}
```

- Without a `type` the button is a text button. `icon`, `fab` and `mini-fab` show only an icon and
  use `label` as the icon name.
- `ariaLabel` (a translation key) is the accessible name. An icon-only button falls back to the
  tooltip, then to the icon name, so give every icon-only button an `ariaLabel` or a `tooltip`.
  `lab900-button` has the same `ariaLabel` input.
- A tooltip is `above` the button by default.
- `subActions` turns the button into a menu, and `action` is then not called. Sub actions nest. Set `keepMenuOpen: true` on a sub
  action to keep the menu open, and call `actionRef.close()` when the work is done.
- `type: 'toggle'` renders a button toggle group. Each sub action is one option; `selected` marks
  the active one.
- Pass `[data]="row"` to give the function forms of the options and `action` a payload. The generic
  `ActionButton<T>` types that payload.
- `align: 'left' | 'right'` places the action in `lab900-page-header`.
- `Lab900ActionDirective` (`[lab900Action]`, `exportAs: 'lab900Action'`) resolves an `ActionButton`
  into signals (`label()`, `disabled()`, `hidden()`, ...) for a custom button template.

## Table

```ts
import { Lab900Sort, Lab900TableComponent, TableCell, TableRowAction } from '@lab900/ui';

interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  address: { city: string };
  active: boolean;
}

@Component({
  imports: [Lab900TableComponent],
  template: `
    <lab900-table
      [tableCells]="tableCells"
      [data]="users()"
      [trackByTableFn]="trackById"
      [loading]="loading()"
      [sort]="sort()"
      (sortChange)="onSort($event)"
      [tableActionsBack]="rowActions"
      [onRowClick]="openUser" />
  `,
})
export class UsersComponent {
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  protected readonly users = signal<User[]>([]);
  protected readonly loading = signal(false);
  protected readonly sort = signal<Lab900Sort[]>([{ id: 'name', direction: 'asc' }]);

  protected readonly tableCells: TableCell<User>[] = [
    { key: 'id', label: 'users.id', width: '80px', sortable: true },
    { key: 'name', label: 'users.name', sortable: true, cellMaxWidth: '240px' },
    { key: 'address.city', label: 'users.city' }, // a dotted key reads a nested value
    { key: 'active', label: 'users.active', cellFormatter: user => (user.active ? 'yes' : 'no') },
  ];

  protected readonly rowActions: TableRowAction<User>[] = [
    { label: 'delete', type: 'icon', ariaLabel: 'users.delete', action: ({ data }) => this.delete(data) },
  ];

  protected readonly trackById = (_index: number, user: User): number => user.id;
  protected readonly openUser = (user: User): void => this.router.navigate(['users', user.id]);

  protected onSort(sort: Lab900Sort[]): void {
    this.sort.set(sort);
    // sort the data yourself, or fetch it sorted from the api
  }
}
```

Required inputs: `tableCells` and `trackByTableFn`. The table sorts nothing itself: a click on a
`sortable` header emits `sortChange` with the new `Lab900Sort[]` (`id` is `sortKey ?? key`). Set
`multiSort` to allow more than one sort column. A sortable header is in the tab order, sorts on
Enter and Space, and sets `aria-sort` from the `sort` input, so keep `sort` in sync.

### `TableCell<T>`

| Field                                            | Meaning                                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `key`                                            | Property to show. `a.b` reads a nested value. Must be unique.                           |
| `label`                                          | Header translation key, or a function of the cell.                                      |
| `cellFormatter(row, cell)`                       | Returns the text to show instead of the raw value.                                      |
| `hide`, `alwaysVisible`, `columnOrder`           | Visibility and order. `alwaysVisible` columns cannot be hidden by users.                |
| `sortable`, `sortKey`                            | Header click emits `sortChange`.                                                        |
| `sticky`, `width`, `cellMaxWidth`                | Layout. A `width` on any column gives the table a fixed layout.                         |
| `cellClass`, `cellHeaderClass`                   | Extra css classes, plain or a function.                                                 |
| `click(row, cell, event)`                        | Click handler for this cell.                                                            |
| `cellTooltip`                                    | `{ text, onlyOnOverflow, tooltipOptions }`. Overflowing text shows a tooltip by itself. |
| `cellHeaderTooltip`, `cellHeaderTooltipPosition` | Tooltip on the header.                                                                  |
| `cellRenderer`, `cellRenderOptions`              | Custom read-only view (see below).                                                      |
| `cellEditor`, `cellEditorOptions`                | Inline editor (see below).                                                              |
| `headerRenderer`, `headerRenderOptions`          | Custom header view.                                                                     |
| `footer`, `footerLoading`, `footerCellClass`     | Footer text: a string, a signal, or a function of all rows.                             |

### Table inputs and outputs

- Content: `data` (model), `loading` (model), `disabled` (model), `tableClass`, `rowClass`,
  `rowColor`, `stickyHeader`, `maxColumnWidth`, `fixedWidth`, `neverHideTable`, `preFooterTitle`.
- Actions: `tableHeaderActions` and `tableFooterActions` (`ActionButton[]`); `tableActionsFront`
  and `tableActionsBack` (`TableRowAction<T>[]`, an `ActionButton<T>` that gets the row as `data`).
  A row action with `draggable: true` turns on drag and drop; handle `tableRowOrderChange`
  (`CdkDragDrop<T[]>`) and reorder `data` yourself.
- Columns: `toggleColumns` shows a menu to hide columns, `toggleAndMoveColumns` also allows
  reordering. `tableCells` is a model, so bind `[(tableCells)]` or listen to `tableCellsChange`
  to keep the user's choice. `tableCellsFiltered` is deprecated.
- Sorting: `sort`, `multiSort`, `disableSort`, output `sortChange`.
- Selection: `selectableRows: SelectableRows<T>` (`enabled`, `singleSelect`, `selectedItems`,
  `maxSelectableRows`, `hideSelectableRow`, `compareFn`, `position`, `sticky`,
  `showSelectAllCheckbox`). Outputs `selectionChanged` (the `SelectionModel<T>`) and
  `rowSelectToggle`.
- Row click: `onRowClick: (row, index, event) => void`. It is an input, not an output.
- Tabs: `tableTabs: Lab900TableTab[]` and `activeTabId` (model). A tab with `tableCells` shows other
  columns.
- Editing: `disabledEditing`, output `cellValueChanged`.
- Expanding: `expandableRows`, `expandedRows` (model), output `rowExpandToggle`.

### Content templates

Import the directive together with `Lab900TableComponent`:

```html
<lab900-table ...>
  <div *lab900TableTopContent>Above the table</div>
  <div *lab900TableHeaderContent>Left of the header actions</div>
  <div *lab900TableEmpty>No results</div>
  <div *lab900TableDisabled>Shown while the table is disabled</div>
  <div *lab900TableLeftFooter>Left of the footer actions</div>
</lab900-table>
```

### Expandable rows

Add a `lab900TableRowDetail` template. A click on a row then shows that template below the row.

```html
<lab900-table
  [tableCells]="tableCells"
  [data]="orders"
  [trackByTableFn]="trackById"
  [expandableRows]="expandableRows"
  [(expandedRows)]="expandedRows">
  <ng-template lab900TableRowDetail [lab900TableRowDetailOf]="orders" let-order let-collapse="collapse">
    <app-order-lines [order]="order" (closed)="collapse()" />
  </ng-template>
</lab900-table>
```

```ts
protected readonly expandedRows = signal<Order[]>([]);
protected readonly expandableRows: ExpandableRows<Order> = {
  multiple: false, // expanding a row collapses the other one
  isExpandable: order => order.lines.length > 0,
};
```

`lab900TableRowDetailOf` only types the context. Use `compareFn` when the data is fetched again as
new objects. From code, call `toggleRowExpansion`, `expandRow`, `collapseRow`, `collapseAllRows` and
`isRowExpanded` on the table instance (`viewChild.required(Lab900TableComponent<Order>)`).

### Inline editing

```ts
protected readonly tableCells: TableCell<User>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    label: 'users.name',
    cellEditor: CellInputEditorComponent,
    cellEditorOptions: { type: 'text', placeholder: 'users.name-placeholder' } satisfies CellInputEditorOptions,
  },
  {
    key: 'role',
    label: 'users.role',
    cellEditor: CellSelectEditorComponent,
    cellEditorOptions: {
      options: ['admin', 'user'],
      optionLabelFn: role => `roles.${role}`,
    } satisfies CellSelectEditorOptions<string, User>,
  },
  { key: 'birthday', label: 'users.birthday', cellEditor: CellDateEditorComponent },
];
```

```ts
protected onCellValueChanged({ value, cell, row }: CellValueChangeEvent<User>): void {
  this.users.update(users => users.map(u => (u.id === row.id ? { ...u, [cell.key]: value } : u)));
}
```

The editor opens when the cell gets a click or focus, and saves on Enter or blur. Tab and the arrow
keys move to the next editable cell. It emits only when the value changed. A column with a `click`
handler does not open its editor on click. Turn editing off per row with `cellEditorOptions.disabled(row)`, or for the whole table with
`[disabledEditing]="true"`. Handle one column with `cellEditorOptions.valueChanged` instead of the
table output.

### Built-in renderers

| Renderer                                         | Options interface                     |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `DefaultCellRendererComponent`                   | none (the default)                    |
| `CellWithIconRendererComponent`                  | `CellWithIconRendererOptions`         |
| `CellWithAnchorRendererComponent`                | `CellWithAnchorRendererOptions`       |
| `CheckboxCellRendererComponent`                  | `CheckboxCellRendererOptions`         |
| `CellWithClearingRendererComponent`              | `CellWithClearingRendererOptions`     |
| `ColumnHeaderWithIconRendererComponent` (header) | `ColumnHeaderWithIconRendererOptions` |

### Custom renderer or editor

Extend the abstract, keep the `lab900-cell-value` class on the element that holds the value (the
overflow tooltip measures it), and pass the class as `cellRenderer`:

```ts
@Component({
  selector: 'app-status-cell',
  template: `<span class="lab900-cell-value status-{{ cellValue() }}">{{ cellValue() | translate }}</span>`,
  imports: [TranslatePipe],
})
export class StatusCellComponent extends CellRendererAbstract<StatusCellOptions, User> {}
```

`CellRendererAbstract` gives you `columnConfig()`, `data()` (the row), `cellValue()`,
`renderOptions()`, `tooltip()` and `disabled()`.

An editor extends `CellEditorAbstract<Options, T, V>`. Read `cellValue()` and `editOptions()`,
give the input the class `lab900-cell-input` (it gets focus when the editor opens), and call
`closeAndSave(value)` to save or `close()` to cancel.

A header renderer extends `ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract<Options, T>` and reads `columnConfig()`.

## Nav list

```ts
protected readonly nav: NavItemGroup[] = [
  {
    label: 'nav.admin',
    items: [
      { label: 'nav.users', icon: { name: 'group' }, route: '/users' },
      { label: 'nav.docs', href: { url: 'https://example.com', target: '_blank' } },
      {
        label: 'nav.settings',
        hide: () => !this.auth.isAdmin(),
        children: [{ label: 'nav.general', route: '/settings/general' }],
      },
    ],
  },
];
```

```html
<lab900-nav-list [navItemGroups]="nav" [showLevelArrows]="true" />
```

Do not set `uniqueId`: the list generates it. An item without a `route`, an `href` or visible
children is not shown, and neither is a group without visible items. Use `navigationFinished` to close a drawer after
navigation, and `routeMatchOptions` to control the active state.

## Page header

```html
<lab900-page-header
  [pageTitle]="'users.title'"
  [breadCrumbs]="breadCrumbs"
  [navItems]="tabs"
  [actions]="actions"
  [data]="user()"
  [tabPanel]="tabPanel" />
<mat-tab-nav-panel #tabPanel>
  <router-outlet />
</mat-tab-nav-panel>
```

Import `MatTabsModule` for `mat-tab-nav-panel`. The tabs only show when `tabPanel` is set. A tab
`route` is relative to the current route. `navItems` (`PageHeaderNavItem[]`) and `breadCrumbs`
(`BreadCrumb[]`) accept functions of `data`, for example `title: user => user.name`.

## Dialogs, alerts, merger

```html
<button mat-button lab900ConfirmationDialog message="users.delete-confirm" (confirmed)="delete()">
  {{ 'delete' | translate }}
</button>

<lab900-alert [type]="Alert.Warn">{{ 'users.unsaved' | translate }}</lab900-alert>
```

`Alert` is an enum (`Info`, `Warn`, `Error`, `Success`); expose it on the class to use it in the
template. The alert and confirmation dialogs open with `MatDialog` and a `data` of type
`AlertDialog` or `ConfirmationDialog`; the confirmation dialog closes with `true` when confirmed.

`lab900-merger` needs `leftObject` and `rightObject` (`MergeObject<T>`: `{ title, data }`) and
`schema` (`MergeConfig<T>[]`). Bind `[(selectedSide)]` to choose the master side, and read the merged
object with `merger.result()` (a signal). A `MergeConfig.component` is a component that
implements `MergerItemComponent<T>` and receives `data`.

## Testing a consumer component

```ts
await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
  imports: [UsersComponent],
  providers: [provideTranslateService(), provideRouter([])],
}).compileComponents();

const fixture = TestBed.createComponent(UsersComponent);
fixture.componentRef.setInput('user', mockUser);
fixture.detectChanges();
```

jsdom lacks `window.matchMedia`, which Material's `MediaMatcher` needs for the nav list. Define it in
your test setup file.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                                        | Fix                                                            |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NullInjectorError: TranslateService`                          | Add `provideTranslateService()` to the app and test providers. |
| No `trackByTableFn` on `lab900-table`                          | It is required. Return a stable id.                            |
| Sort click does nothing                                        | Handle `sortChange` and sort `data` yourself.                  |
| Edited value disappears                                        | Handle `cellValueChanged` and write the value into `data`.     |
| Mutating a config object to change a button                    | Use a signal or a function in the reactive option.             |
| `(rowClick)` on the table                                      | There is no such output. Use the `[onRowClick]` input.         |
| `CellDateEditorComponent` throws `No provider for DateAdapter` | Add `provideNativeDateAdapter()` or another adapter.           |
| Deep import from `@lab900/ui/lib/...`                          | Import from `@lab900/ui`.                                      |
| Icon-only button without a name for screen readers             | Set `ariaLabel` or a `tooltip` on the `ActionButton`.          |

# API reference

Generated from the source of `@lab900/ui`.

## Components

### AlertComponent

Selector: `lab900-alert`

A colored message box. The content is projected, for example
`<lab900-alert [type]="Alert.Warn">Unsaved changes</lab900-alert>`.

- `type` (input, default `Alert.Info`): `Alert` — Sets the color and the meaning of the alert

### AlertDialogComponent

Selector: `lab900-alert-dialog`

### BreadCrumbsComponent

Selector: `lab900-bread-crumbs`

A breadcrumb trail. The last crumb is the current page. The page header shows one for its `breadCrumbs`.

- `breadCrumbs` (input, required): `BreadCrumb[]`
- `data` (input): `any` — The data that the function options of the crumbs receive

### CellDateEditorComponent

Selector: `lab900-cell-date-editor`

Extends: `CellEditorAbstract<CellEditorBaseOptions>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellEditorAbstract): `TableCell<T, any, any, TCellEditorOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellEditorAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellEditorAbstract): `(value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void`

### CellInputEditorComponent

Selector: `lab900-cell-edit-input-renderer`

Extends: `CellEditorAbstract<CellInputEditorOptions>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellEditorAbstract): `TableCell<T, any, any, TCellEditorOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellEditorAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellEditorAbstract): `(value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void`

### CellSelectEditorComponent

Selector: `lab900-cell-select-editor`

Extends: `CellEditorAbstract<CellSelectEditorOptions>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellEditorAbstract): `TableCell<T, any, any, TCellEditorOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellEditorAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellEditorAbstract): `(value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void`

### CellWithAnchorRendererComponent<T = any>

Selector: `lab900-cell-with-anchor`

Extends: `CellRendererAbstract<CellWithAnchorRendererOptions<T>, T>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `TableCell<T, CellRenderOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellRendererAbstract): `((value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void) | undefined`

### CellWithClearingRendererComponent<T = any>

Selector: `lab900-cell-with-clearing-renderer`

Extends: `CellRendererAbstract<CellWithClearingRendererOptions, T>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `TableCell<T, CellRenderOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellRendererAbstract): `((value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void) | undefined`

### CellWithIconRendererComponent<T = any>

Selector: `lab900-cell-with-icon-renderer`

Extends: `CellRendererAbstract<CellWithIconRendererOptions<T>, T>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `TableCell<T, CellRenderOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellRendererAbstract): `((value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void) | undefined`

### CheckboxCellRendererComponent

Selector: `lab900-checkbox-cell-renderer`

Extends: `CellRendererAbstract<CheckboxCellRendererOptions>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `TableCell<T, CellRenderOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellRendererAbstract): `((value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void) | undefined`

### ColumnHeaderSortingComponent

Selector: `lab900-column-header-sorting`

- `columnConfig` (input, required): `TableCell`

### ColumnHeaderWithIconRendererComponent

Selector: `lab900-default-column-header-renderer`

Extends: `ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract<ColumnHeaderWithIconRendererOptions>`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract): `TableCell<T>`
- `disableSort` (input, default `false`, from ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract): `boolean`

### ConfirmationDialogComponent

Selector: `lab900-confirmation-dialog`

### DefaultCellRendererComponent

Selector: `lab900-default-cell-renderer`

Extends: `CellRendererAbstract`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `TableCell<T, CellRenderOptions>`
- `data` (model, required, from CellRendererAbstract): `T`
- `handleValueChanged` (input, from CellRendererAbstract): `((value: V, cell: TableCell<T>, row: T) => void) | undefined`

### DefaultColumnHeaderRendererComponent

Selector: `lab900-default-column-header-renderer`

Extends: `ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract`

- `columnConfig` (input, required, from ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract): `TableCell<T>`
- `disableSort` (input, default `false`, from ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract): `boolean`

### IconComponent

Selector: `lab900-icon`

Shows an Icon config as a Material icon or a registered SVG icon

- `icon` (input, required): `Icon`

### Lab900ActionButtonComponent<T = undefined>

Selector: `lab900-action-button`

Extends: `Lab900ActionDirective<T>`

A button built from an ActionButton config. With sub actions it opens a menu, with the `toggle` type it is a
button toggle group.

- `action` (input, required, from Lab900ActionDirective): `ActionButton<T>` — The config of the button
- `data` (input, from Lab900ActionDirective): `T | undefined` — The data that the function options of the config receive

### Lab900ActionButtonToggleComponent<T = undefined>

Selector: `lab900-action-button-toggle`

Extends: `Lab900ActionDirective<T>`

A button toggle group with one option per sub action. `lab900-action-button` renders it for the `toggle` type.

- `action` (input, required, from Lab900ActionDirective): `ActionButton<T>` — The config of the button
- `data` (input, from Lab900ActionDirective): `T | undefined` — The data that the function options of the config receive

### Lab900ButtonComponent

Selector: `lab900-button`

A Material button of any type, with icons and a translated label. Clicks are throttled, so a double click
emits `btnClick` once.

- `type` (input): `Lab900ButtonType | undefined` — The Material button variant. Without a type it is a text button.
- `color` (input, default `'primary'`): `ThemePalette`
- `suffixIcon` (input): `string | undefined` — Material icon name after the label. Not shown on the icon and fab types.
- `prefixIcon` (input): `string | undefined` — Material icon name before the label. Not shown on the icon and fab types.
- `label` (input, required): `string` — A translation key. For the icon and fab types it is the icon name instead.
- `ariaLabel` (input): `string | undefined` — A translation key for the accessible name of the button. Set it on the icon and fab types: without it, a screen reader reads the icon name.
- `disabled` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `svgIcon` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — Read the icon names as names of icons registered in the `MatIconRegistry`, not as Material icon names.
- `buttonType` (input, default `'button'`): `'button' | 'reset' | 'submit'` — The `type` attribute of the `<button>` element. Use `submit` to submit a form.
- `containerClass` (input): `string | undefined` — CSS classes on the `<button>` element
- `buttonId` (input): `string | undefined` — The `id` of the `<button>` element
- `throttleTimeInMs` (input, default `500`): `number` — Clicks within this time after the previous click are ignored
- `btnClick` (output): `Event` — Emits on a click, at most once per `throttleTimeInMs`

### Lab900MergerComponent<T>

Selector: `lab900-merger`

Compares two objects side by side, one row per schema config, and lets the user pick values from the other side.
Rows with a difference get an arrow; a click on it merges that value.

- `leftObject` (input, required): `MergeObject<T>`
- `rightObject` (input, required): `MergeObject<T>`
- `fixed` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — Keep `selectedSide`: the user cannot switch the side that the merge starts from
- `loading` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — Show a progress bar instead of the rows
- `schema` (input, required): `MergeConfig<T>[]` — One row per config. The order of the configs is the order of the rows.
- `selectedSide` (model, default `'right'`): `'left' | 'right'` — The side that the merge starts from. The active values of the other side are merged into it.
- `schemaChange` (output): `MergeConfig<T>[]` — Emits the schema with the choices of the user: `active` is set on the configs that are merged
- `resultChange` (output): `T` — Emits the merged object after every change

### Lab900MergerItemComponent<T>

Selector: `lab900-merger-item`

One side of a merger row. The merger renders it; you only need it to build your own merger layout.

- `config` (input, required): `MergeConfig<T>`
- `data` (input, required): `T` — The whole object of this side
- `active` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — Highlight the item as the side that the merge starts from

### Lab900NavListComponent

Selector: `lab900-nav-list`

A navigation menu of grouped items, with nested levels. Hidden items and empty groups are left out.

- `navItemGroups` (input, required): `NavItemGroup[]`
- `indentLevels` (input, default `true`): `boolean` — Indent nested items by their level
- `showLevelArrows` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — Show an arrow on items with children, which shows whether they are expanded
- `allowOverlayMenuUntil` (input, default `Breakpoints.XSmall`): `string | string[]` — Media queries, for example the CDK `Breakpoints`, where items with `childrenInOverlay` expand below the item instead of in an overlay
- `routeMatchOptions` (input): `IsActiveMatchOptions | { exact: boolean } | undefined` — When an item is active. An item can override it. Without it, an item is active on its route and the routes below it (`{ exact: false }`).

### Lab900PageHeaderComponent

Selector: `lab900-page-header`

The header of a page: a title, breadcrumbs, actions and tabs that link to routes.

- `pageTitle` (input): `string` — A translation key
- `pageTitleArgs` (input): `object` — The parameters of the title translation
- `navItems` (input): `PageHeaderNavItem[]` — Tabs below the title. They only show together with `tabPanel`.
- `tabPanel` (input): `MatTabNavPanel` — The corresponding <router-outlet> must be wrapped in an <mat-tab-nav-panel> component and should typically be placed relatively close to this component
- `showActionsFixedOnMobile` (input): `boolean` — On screens narrower than 960px, show the actions in a bar fixed to the bottom of the screen
- `navFitInkBarToContent` (input): `boolean` — Make the ink bar of the active tab as wide as its label instead of the whole tab
- `actions` (input): `ActionButton[]` — Buttons next to the title. Set `align: 'left'` on an action to put it right after the title.
- `data` (input): `any` — The data that the function options of the actions, breadcrumbs and tabs receive
- `breadCrumbs` (input): `BreadCrumb[]` — Breadcrumbs below the title

### Lab900TableCellComponent<T = any>

Selector: `lab900-table-cell[cell]`

- `cell` (input, required): `TableCell<T>`
- `data` (input, required): `T[]`
- `disableSort` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `maxColumnWidthFromTable` (input): `string | undefined`
- `showFooterCell` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `headerClick` (output): `TableCell<T>`
- `valueChanged` (output): `CellValueChangeEvent<T>`

### Lab900TableComponent<T extends object = object, TabId = string>

Selector: `lab900-table`

- `fixedWidth` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — This will respect the defined widths of the table cells If any cell has a width defined, the table will have a fixed layout
- `tableCells` (model, required): `TableCell<T>[]`
- `tableTabs` (input): `Lab900TableTab<TabId, T>[] | undefined`
- `activeTabId` (model): `TabId | undefined`
- `tableClass` (input, default `''`): `string`
- `rowClass` (input): `((data: T) => string) | string | undefined`
- `rowColor` (input): `((data: T) => string) | string | undefined`
- `loading` (model, default `false`): `boolean`
- `tableHeaderActions` (input, default `[]`): `ActionButton[]` — Show a set of actions at the top of the table
- `tableFooterActions` (input, default `[]`): `ActionButton[]` — Show a set of actions at the bottom of the table
- `tableActionsFront` (input, default `[]`): `TableRowAction<T>[]` — Show a set of actions at the start of each row
- `tableActionsBack` (input, default `[]`): `TableRowAction<T>[]` — Show a set of actions at the end of each row
- `selectableRows` (input): `SelectableRows<T> | undefined`
- `expandableRows` (input): `ExpandableRows<T> | undefined` — Options for rows that expand on click. Expanding needs a `lab900TableRowDetail` template.
- `expandedRows` (model, default `[]`): `T[]` — The expanded rows. Bind it two-way to expand or collapse rows from the parent.
- `toggleColumns` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — Show columns filter to hide/show columns
- `toggleAndMoveColumns` (input, default `false`): `boolean` — Show columns filter to hide/show columns AND show rearrange option This overrides toggleColumns field
- `filterIcon` (input, default `'filter_alt'`): `string`
- `showFilterHeader` (input, default `true`): `boolean`
- `neverHideTable` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `disabled` (model, default `false`): `boolean`
- `sort` (input): `Lab900Sort[] | undefined`
- `multiSort` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `disableSort` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `maxColumnWidth` (input): `string | undefined` — set max width of all columns, can be individually overwritten per tableCell this will create a tooltip with the content of the cell, when the text overflows
- `onRowClick` (input): `((value: T, index: number, event: Event) => void) | undefined`
- `preFooterTitle` (input): `string | undefined`
- `stickyHeader` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `trackByTableFn` (input, required): `TrackByFunction<T>`
- `disabledEditing` (input): `boolean`
- `selectionChanged` (output): `SelectionModel<T>`
- `rowSelectToggle` (output): `T`
- `tableCellsFiltered` (output, deprecated): `TableCell<T>[]`
- `tableRowOrderChange` (output): `CdkDragDrop<T[]>`
- `cellValueChanged` (output): `CellValueChangeEvent<T>`
- `sortChange` (output): `Lab900Sort[]`
- `rowExpandToggle` (output): `{ row: T; expanded: boolean }`
- `data` (model): `T[] | null | undefined`

### Lab900TableFilterMenuComponent

Selector: `lab900-table-filter-menu`

- `filterIcon` (input, default `'filter_alt'`): `string`
- `showFilterHeader` (input, default `true`): `boolean`
- `toggleAndMoveColumns` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `filterChanged` (output): `TableCell[]`

### Lab900TableHeaderComponent

Selector: `lab900-table-header`

- `tableHeaderContent` (input): `TemplateRef<any> | undefined`
- `tableHeaderActions` (input, default `[]`): `ActionButton[]`
- `filterIcon` (input, default `'filter_alt'`): `string`
- `showFilterHeader` (input, default `true`): `boolean`
- `toggleAndMoveColumns` (input, default `false`): `boolean`
- `toggleColumns` (input, default `true`): `boolean`
- `tableCellsFiltered` (output): `TableCell[]`

### Lab900TableTabsComponent<TabId = string, T extends object = object>

- `activeTabId` (model, required): `TabId`

### PageHeaderNavItemComponent

One tab of the page header. The page header renders it for each of its `navItems`.

- `item` (input, required): `PageHeaderNavItem`
- `data` (input): `any` — The data that the function options of the item receive

### Lab900ActionDirective<T = undefined>

Selector: `[lab900Action]`

Resolves an ActionButton config into signals: label, icons, disabled, hidden and tooltip. The action buttons
extend it; use it on your own element to render an action your way.

- `action` (input, required): `ActionButton<T>` — The config of the button
- `data` (input): `T | undefined` — The data that the function options of the config receive

### Lab900TableRowDetailDirective<T = any>

Selector: `[lab900TableRowDetail]`

Content of an expanded row. The table renders it below the row, over the full width of the table.

- `lab900TableRowDetailOf` (input): `T[] | null | undefined` — Only used to type the template context, pass the same data as the table.

### Lab900TableTopContentDirective

Selector: `[lab900TableTopContent]`

### PreventDoubleClickDirective

Selector: `[lab900PreventDoubleClick]`

Ignores the clicks that follow a click within `throttleTimeInMs`. Listen to `throttledClick` instead of `click`.

- `throttleTimeInMs` (input, default `500`): `number` — Clicks within this time after the previous click are ignored
- `throttledClick` (output): `Event` — Emits on a click, at most once per `throttleTimeInMs`

### TableCellEventsDirective<T = any>

- `cellData` (input, required): `T`
- `cell` (input, required): `TableCell<T>`
- `rowIndex` (input, required): `number`

## Interfaces

### ActionButton<T = undefined>

The config of a `lab900-action-button`. The page header and the table take lists of them.
`T` is the type of the data that the function options receive.

- `label` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveStringOption<T>` — A translation key. For the icon and fab types it is the icon name instead.
- `ariaLabel?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveStringOption<T>` — A translation key for the accessible name of the button. The icon and fab types fall back to the tooltip, then to the icon name, so set it on an icon button without a tooltip.
- `action?`: `(event: ActionButtonEvent<T>) => void` — Runs on a click. Not called when the button has sub actions: the button then opens them.
- `type?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveOption<T, 'toggle' | Lab900ButtonType>` — The Material button variant, or `toggle` for a button toggle group of the sub actions. Without a type it is a text button.
- `color?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveOption<T, ThemePalette>`
- `disabled?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveBooleanOption<T>`
- `selected?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveBooleanOption<T>` — On a sub action of a toggle: the option that is selected
- `hide?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveBooleanOption<T>`
- `subActions?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveOption<T, ActionButton<T>[]>` — Actions in a menu that the button opens. With the `toggle` type they are the options of the toggle group.
- `tooltip?` (accepts a signal): `{ value: ReactiveStringOption<T>; position?: 'left' | 'right' | 'above' | 'below' | 'before' | 'after' }` — A tooltip with a translation key. The position is `above` by default.
- `suffixIcon?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveStringOption<T>` — Material icon name after the label
- `prefixIcon?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveStringOption<T>` — Material icon name before the label
- `svgIcon?`: `boolean` — Read the icon names as names of icons registered in the `MatIconRegistry`
- `containerClass?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveStringOption<T>` — CSS classes on the `<button>` element
- `buttonId?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveStringOption<T>` — The `id` of the `<button>` element
- `align?`: `'left' | 'right'` — In the page header: the side of the header that the button is on
- `hideSelectionIndicator?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveBooleanOption<T>` — On a toggle: hide the check mark of the selected option
- `keepMenuOpen?` (accepts a signal): `ReactiveBooleanOption<T>` — On a sub action in a menu: keep the menu open after a click

### ActionButtonEvent<T = undefined>

What the `action` function of an ActionButton receives

- `event`: `Event` — The click event
- `data`: `T` — The data of the button, for example the row of a table
- `actionRef`: `Lab900ActionDirective<T>` — The directive that resolved the button

### AlertDialog

- `message?`: `string`
- `okButtonText?`: `string`
- `messageHTML?`: `string`

### BreadCrumb

One crumb of a breadcrumb trail. The function options receive the `data` of the trail.

- `title`: `((data: any) => string) | string` — A translation key
- `route`: `((data: any) => string) | string` — The router link of the crumb. A crumb without a route is plain text.
- `queryParams?`: `((data: any) => object) | object` — The query params of the link
- `divider?`: `string` — The text between this crumb and the next one

### CellEditorBaseOptions<T = any>

- `valueChanged?`: `(event: CellValueChangeEvent<T>) => void` — Callback when the value of the editor changes Can also be handled globally via the table
- `disabled?`: `(data?: T) => boolean` — Disable the editor based on the row data Can also be done globally via the table
- `placeholder?`: `string` — Show a placeholder when no value is present
- `disablePlaceholderOutsideEditor?`: `boolean` — Don't display the placeholder in the normal view when no value is present

### CellInputEditorOptions

Extends: `CellEditorBaseOptions`

- `type?`: `(| 'number' | 'search' | 'button' | 'time' | 'image' | 'text' | 'checkbox' | 'color' | 'date' | 'datetime-local' | 'email' | 'file' | 'hidden' | 'month' | 'password' | 'radio' | 'range')`
- `maxLength?`: `number`

### CellSelectEditorOptions<O = any, T = any>

Extends: `CellEditorBaseOptions<T>`

- `options`: `O[] | ((data: T) => O[])`
- `compareWithFn?`: `(o1: O, o2: O) => boolean`
- `optionLabelFn?`: `(o: O) => string`
- `multiple?`: `boolean`
- `panelWidth?`: `string | number | null`

### CellValueChangeEvent<T = any>

- `value`: `any`
- `cell`: `TableCell<T>`
- `row`: `T`

### CellWithAnchorRendererOptions<T = any>

- `url`: `(data: T) => string`
- `target?`: `string`

### CellWithClearingRendererOptions

- `showClose?`: `boolean`

### CellWithIconRendererOptions<T = any>

- `icon`: `(data: T) => string`
- `svgIcon?`: `boolean`
- `showCellValue?`: `boolean`

### CheckboxCellRendererOptions

- `indeterminate?`: `boolean`
- `theme?`: `ThemePalette`

### ColumnHeaderWithIconRendererOptions

- `icon`: `string`
- `svgIcon?`: `boolean`

### ConfirmationDialog

Extends: `AlertDialog`

- `cancelButtonText?`: `string`

### ExpandableRows<T = any>

- `enabled?` (default `true`): `boolean` — Rows expand when the table has a `lab900TableRowDetail` template. Set this to false to turn expanding off without removing the template.
- `multiple?` (default `true`): `boolean` — Allow more than one expanded row at a time. With false, expanding a row collapses the other one.
- `isExpandable?`: `(row: T) => boolean` — Decide per row if it can expand. It is evaluated when the row renders.
- `compareFn?` (default `strict equality`): `(o1: T, o2: T) => boolean` — Compare rows to find the expanded ones, for example when the data is fetched again as new objects.

### Icon

An icon of a nav item or group. Set `name` or `svgName`.

- `name?`: `string` — A Material icon name
- `svgName?`: `string` — The name of an icon registered in the `MatIconRegistry`
- `position?`: `'left' | 'right'` — The side of the label that the icon is on

### Lab900Sort

- `id`: `string` — The id of the column being sorted.
- `direction`: `'asc' | 'desc' | ''` — The sort direction.

### Lab900TableRowDetailContext<T = any>

- `$implicit`: `T`
- `index`: `number`
- `collapse`: `() => void`

### Lab900TableTab<TabId = string, T extends object = object>

- `id`: `TabId`
- `label`: `string`
- `tableCells?`: `TableCell<T>[]` — Load a different config for a tab

### MergeConfig<T>

Extends: `MergeConfigBase`

One row of the merger

- `rowClass?`: `string` — CSS classes on the row
- `nextLine?`: `boolean` — Show the value below the label instead of next to it
- `active?`: `boolean` — Merge the value of the other side. The user sets it with the arrow of the row; set it to start merged.
- `component?`: `Type<MergerItemComponent<T>>` — A component that shows the row instead of the label and value. It receives the whole object as `data`.
- `nestedObject?`: `MergeConfigBase[]` — Fields shown together in one row and merged together. With an `attribute` the fields are properties of that object property, and the whole object is merged. Without it they are top-level properties.
- `combine?`: `boolean` — Merge an array property by joining both arrays instead of replacing one
- `disabled?`: `boolean` — The user cannot change `active`, and a reset keeps it

### MergeConfigBase

A property to show. It is also the type of the fields in `nestedObject`.

- `attribute?`: `string` — The property of the object
- `label?`: `string` — A translation key, shown next to the value
- `formatter?`: `(data: any) => Observable<string> | string` — Turns the value into the text of the row. It can return an observable.

### MergeObject<T>

One side of the merger

- `data`: `T` — The object to compare
- `title`: `string` — The heading above this side

### MergerItemComponent<T = any>

Contract for a custom component that shows the value of a merge config.
The merger sets the data with setInput, so a signal input and a decorator input are both possible.

- `data?`: `T | Signal<T | undefined>` — The whole object of the side that the component is on

### NavItem

One entry of a nav list: a route, an external link, or a parent of nested items.
An item without a route, a link or visible children is not shown.

- `label`: `string` — A translation key
- `icon?`: `Icon`
- `route?`: `string` — The router link of the item
- `routeQueryParams?`: `Record<string, any>` — The query params of the route
- `href?`: `{ url: string; target?: '_self' | '_blank' }` — An external link instead of a route
- `children?`: `NavItem[]` — Nested items. A click on the parent expands them; the parent of the active route starts expanded.
- `childrenInOverlay?`: `boolean` — Show the children in an overlay instead of below the item, on screens wider than `allowOverlayMenuUntil` of the list
- `hide?`: `(() => boolean) | boolean`
- `navigationFinished?`: `(navigationResult: boolean | null) => void` — Called after the navigation to the route of the item has finished, for example to close a sidenav
- `routeMatchOptions?`: `IsActiveMatchOptions | { exact: boolean }` — When the item is active. Overrides the `routeMatchOptions` of the list.
- `uniqueId?`: `string` — Will be automatically generated

### NavItemGroup

A group of nav items with an optional heading. A group without visible items is not shown.

- `label?`: `string` — A translation key for the heading of the group
- `items`: `NavItem[]`
- `icon?`: `Icon` — An icon next to the heading
- `hide?`: `(() => boolean) | boolean`
- `uniqueId?`: `string` — Will be automatically generated

### PageHeaderNavItem<T = any>

A tab of the page header. The tab links to a route and is active while that route is.
`T` is the type of the `data` of the page header, which the function options receive.

- `label`: `((data: T) => string) | string` — A translation key
- `route?`: `((data: T) => string) | string` — The router link of the tab, relative to the current route. Without a route the tab links to the current route.
- `queryParams?`: `((data: T) => Record<string, any>) | Record<string, any>` — The query params of the link
- `suffixIcon?`: `((data: T) => string) | string` — Material icon name after the label
- `prefixIcon?`: `((data: T) => string) | string` — Material icon name before the label
- `svgIcon?`: `((data: T) => boolean) | boolean` — Read the icon names as names of icons registered in the `MatIconRegistry`

### SelectableRows<T = any>

- `enabled`: `boolean`
- `checkBoxColor?`: `ThemePalette`
- `position?`: `'right' | 'left'`
- `sticky?`: `boolean`
- `showSelectAllCheckbox?`: `boolean`
- `disabled?`: `boolean`
- `maxSelectableRows?`: `number`
- `selectedItems?`: `T[]`
- `singleSelect?`: `boolean`
- `hideSelectableRow?`: `(row: T) => boolean`
- `compareFn?`: `(o1: T, o2: T) => boolean`

### TableCell<T = any, CellRenderOptions = any, HeaderRenderOptions = any, CellEditorOptions extends CellEditorBaseOptions = CellEditorBaseOptions>

- `key`: `string` — Column key
- `label` (accepts a function): `propValue<TableCell>` — Column header label
- `cellClass?`: `((data: T, cell: TableCell) => string) | string` — Custom cell class
- `cellHeaderClass?` (accepts a function): `propValue<TableCell<T>>` — Custom cell header class
- `cellFormatter?`: `(data: T, cell: TableCell) => string` — Custom formatter to display data inside the cell
- `hide?`: `boolean` — Should show column in the table
- `columnOrder?`: `number` — Order of the column in the table Sorted fields will come before non-sorted fields
- `alwaysVisible?`: `boolean` — Can't hide the column
- `sortable?`: `boolean` — Column is sortable
- `sortKey?`: `string` — sort key to be used defaults to `key` if not defined
- `sticky?`: `boolean` — Column is sticky
- `width?`: `string` — Column width
- `click?`: `(data: T, cell: TableCell, mouseEvent?: MouseEvent) => unknown` — on click
- `cellRenderer?`: `Type<CellRendererAbstract<CellRenderOptions, T>>` — Specify a custom cell renderer component to display the cell content in a different way
- `cellRenderOptions?`: `CellRenderOptions` — Specify cellRenderer component specific options
- `cellEditor?`: `Type<CellEditorAbstract<CellEditorOptions, T>>`
- `cellEditorOptions?`: `CellEditorOptions`
- `headerRenderer?`: `Type<ColumnHeaderRendererAbstract<HeaderRenderOptions, T>>` — Specify a custom header renderer component to display the column header content in a different way
- `headerRenderOptions?`: `HeaderRenderOptions` — Specify headerRenderer component specific options
- `cellHeaderTooltip?`: `string` — Enable a tooltip for cell header, takes text to be displayed
- `cellHeaderTooltipPosition?`: `TooltipPosition` — Define the position for the cell header tooltip
- `cellTooltip?`: `TableCellTooltip<T>` — Enable a tooltip, displays the cell content in a tooltip
- `cellMaxWidth?`: `string` — set max width of column, this will cause the content to overflow
- `footer?`: `((data: T[], cell: TableCell) => string | Signal<string>) | string | Signal<string>` — Cell footer to be displayed
- `footerLoading?`: `Signal<boolean>`
- `footerCellClass?`: `string`

### TableCellTooltip<T = unknown>

- `text?` (accepts a function): `propValue<T>` — Text that is displayed in the tooltip, can be dependent on data
- `onlyOnOverflow?` (accepts a function, default `false`): `propValue<T, boolean>` — If true, tooltip will only show when it is the content of the cell is cut off (by setting TableCell.cellMaxWidth value)
- `tooltipOptions?`: `{ tooltipPosition: 'left' | 'right' | 'above' | 'below' | 'before' | 'after' }` — Currently ony supports positioning option of matTooltip

### TableRowAction<T = any>

Extends: `ActionButton<T>`

- `draggable?`: `boolean` — Enable drag & drop for the table rows

### TooltipOptions

- `tooltipPosition?`: `'left' | 'right' | 'above' | 'below' | 'before' | 'after'`

## Types

### Lab900ButtonType

The Material button variants. `icon`, `fab` and `mini-fab` show only an icon.

```ts
type Lab900ButtonType = 'raised' | 'stroked' | 'flat' | 'icon' | 'fab' | 'mini-fab'
```

### propValue<T = unknown, R = string>

```ts
type propValue = ((data?: T) => R) | R
```

### ReactiveBooleanOption<PAYLOAD>

```ts
type ReactiveBooleanOption = ReactiveOption<PAYLOAD, boolean>
```

### ReactiveNumberOption<PAYLOAD>

```ts
type ReactiveNumberOption = ReactiveOption<PAYLOAD, number>
```

### ReactiveOption<PAYLOAD, RETURN_TYPE>

```ts
type ReactiveOption = RETURN_TYPE | ((data: PAYLOAD) => RETURN_TYPE | Signal<RETURN_TYPE>) | Signal<RETURN_TYPE>
```

### ReactiveStringOption<PAYLOAD>

```ts
type ReactiveStringOption = ReactiveOption<PAYLOAD, string>
```

## Enums

### Alert

The types of `lab900-alert`. Expose the enum on your component to bind it, for example `[type]="Alert.Error"`.

```ts
enum Alert = { Info = 'INFO', Warn = 'WARN', Error = 'ERROR', Success = 'SUCCESS' }
```
